Frame grouping is essential to distinguish panels. No physical body/distance/tidal-height scale;no water bulge geometry,shoreline levels,season/daily-cycle/eclipses/forecast claim. Native738 has two collinear rows with changed circle order/sizes;its labels and a right-angle neap panel are not established. The chosen right-angle panel is an independent declared model supported by NOAA text,not native geometry preservation.", "geometry_choice": "All body radii,positions and panel frames introduced for separation/recognition keys. Only a selected spring and selected neap angular relationship is shown;not a complete lunar month or operational tidal prediction.", "original_sources_unchanged": true}, {"type": "native Index line sampling", "continuous_curves_unchanged": true, "phase_choices": []}], "source_limit": "Two teacher-keyed angular-alignment panels;Sun/Earth/Moon are outlined body pictures,not filled category-point markers. Frame grouping is essential to distinguish panels. No physical body/distance/tidal-height scale;no water bulge geometry,shoreline levels,season/daily-cycle/eclipses/forecast claim. Native738 has two collinear rows with changed circle order/sizes;its labels and a right-angle neap panel are not established. The chosen right-angle panel is an independent declared model supported by NOAA text,not native geometry preservation. External accessible identity/row/state/view/role keys and learner scaffolding required. Nominal dimensions are introduced,not measured data;physical calibration/device/pagefit/touch/recognition pending.", "geometry_exception": "Native1.2mm graphic line dots/global3.1mm centre guard;not Braille or semantic points. All actual source-model joins,corners and curve extrema fixed. Bounded quarter-mm phases/private repositions preserve continuous geometry;initial grid misses are distinct from final interval ranges. All astronomical discs are body-outline pictures,not filled point symbols;panel frames only group the two alignment cases. Final per-path maxima and local trials retained;no global optimum/physical traceability/device fit claim. Swell/ViewPlus share compatible1.4mmnativepaths. Actualmedium/contacts/size/source limits are perconcept;hardware/fit/recognitionpending."}
